name: group-less-domains-audit
body:
Widened-invariant audit of domain structure (I7 + containment completeness). Three findings:

(1) item-context containment — FIXED [autonomous]. Inconsistency: domain.value.item-context (added by the nested-sections change; see domain.note.nested-sections-domain) was the only domain.value.* node with no containing domain.group — the other 21 values all sit in a group. The nested-sections note's "attaches by a drives edge only" described the realised-by spine (values carry no realised-by), not group membership. Resolution: added contains domain.group.templating -> domain.value.item-context. Evidence: domain.constraint.template-context-reserved attaches-to domain.group.templating and (per requirements.note.nested-sections-requirements) now covers the reserved `item` context; the sibling reserved-context value domain.value.slide-metadata also lives in domain.group.templating.

(2) render-sections containment — FIXED [with user]. Inconsistency: domain.service.render-sections (added by solution.note.nested-sections-coverage-reconcile) was the only domain.service.* node with no containing domain.group — the other 12 services are all contained. Ambiguity: domain.group.presentation ("rendering a valid deck to reveal.js HTML, serving, watching and live-reloading") owns domain.service.render-deck, the deck renderer it was split from; domain.group.templating owns domain.service.template-registry and is the one group that realises solution.component.renderer, which realises render-sections. Human-gate choice: (a1) contains domain.group.presentation -> domain.service.render-sections (rendering-pipeline grouping) — CHOSEN, because render-sections is the section half of the deck-render pipeline whose whole-deck half (render-deck) presentation already owns. Alternative (a2) contains domain.group.templating -> domain.service.render-sections (section-template/context grouping) — NOT taken: templating owns the template library, its registry and its loader, not the deck-rendering pipeline. Resolution: added contains domain.group.presentation -> domain.service.render-sections; render-sections stays realised-by solution.component.renderer and driven by template-language/template-context/section-template-context/item-context/deck-data-in-templates; domain containment is now 13/13 services, 0 uncontained.

(3) upgrade/validation groups without an entity — JUSTIFIED. Inconsistency: domain.group.upgrade and domain.group.validation contain no domain.entity (the other four groups each contain >=1). The model treats them as capability/process groups: their bodies describe a capability ("bringing an existing kalide project forward...", "checking a deck against templates and rules fail-fast"), and neither carries a `root` (authoring=deck, templating=template, distribution=release), so there is no aggregate entity to own. Left as-is; no entity invented [autonomous].
